summary: Scoped documentation-coherence review of PR331 at c3bcd3cf8 against pre-cleanup head 34f227cc1. Most of the new narrative holds up against the evidence in the checkout. It includes PR326 (98f344a32) and the EndRun repair (fa695530a), keeps PR299's detached CPU Step lifetime, and gives exact identities for the baseline, master, the measured runtime (5bd5c7ba), the tested code (dc59d0b94), the review snapshot (c7f91b1) and the CI bundle (34f227cc1). The 1,438 Perlmutter selected checks (6/17/1,398/15/2, one slow sweep deselected, no skips) match verification.json rows 01-06. The GitHub CI claims (114 passed/3 skipped, 17 callback dots including test_fresh_callback_per_run[mpi], six lifetime dots, merge 72209fb into 546764e0) match ci-receipt.json and the workflow selection. The document says plainly that the overlapping suites must not be added together. The performance table matches the frozen report exactly. It is applied only to 5bd5c7ba, and the inconclusive cases stay inconclusive after acceptance. Raw-evidence archival and Seema's review are still open, and nothing authorizes a merge. The #209 race is stated as a nonblocking follow-up, with no claim that it was reproduced or fixed. merge_decisions.md and validation.md have dated pointers, and the frozen report and combined README are left unchanged as the scope requires. One blocking problem remains: the PR body states that 'PR326 alone was not sufficient', but no inspected evidence supports it. The evidence shows the opposite gap: the EndRun repair without PR326 timed out (prior-review/review.json, R1-CI-EXACT-MPI-TIMEOUT). No PR331+PR326 run without the EndRun repair is recorded. Two minor wording issues are nonblocking.

findings.evidence: The row says 'PR326 alone was not sufficient; the EndRun repair is also included.' No inspected record shows a test of PR331+PR326 without the EndRun repair. The recorded evidence shows the reverse: prior-review/review.json (reviewed fa695530a, pr326_absent true) reports that the exact test timed out twice without PR326. The earlier combined diagnostic 61944094 with PR326 passed. performance_20261124.md lines 98-102 says only that PR326 is 'not proof that this exact callback test passes'. That is not evidence that PR326 alone fails. This is a new causal claim in the published PR body without support, and it may reverse the actual finding.
findings.requested_change: Replace the sentence with a statement the evidence supports. For example: 'The EndRun repair alone timed out on this test (prior review R1-CI-EXACT-MPI-TIMEOUT); the pass requires the combined PR326 transport fixes and EndRun repair. PR326 without the EndRun repair was not separately tested on this test.' Alternatively, cite a recorded PR326-only failure if one exists.

It also says it ran no commands and did not recompute hashes. Line 142 points to 'review limits', but the summary sentence alone could be read as a full review of the combined merge.
